sentence.en: Every grain carries someone’s season of work.

set.name: Mohar
set.mechanism: A trader's seal: संगत cut through a gold stamp is the mark, the high-contrast Indian display face is the seal's voice, and a night-forest ground lets the gold stamp carry the pack.
set.expression_move: The gold Devanagari seal on a dark ground.
set.differs_by: Heritage without monuments: a living craft instead of a palace, and dark forest instead of maroon; the only dark-ground premium pack on a light or red shelf.

logo.concept: The name in Devanagari, cut through a gold seal: Sangat stamped as a promise.

defaults_used.why: The square is the seal itself (a mohar is a stamp block); the Devanagari name is cut through it, so it is not an initial in an app tile.

rationale.claim: A trader's seal: संगत cut through a gold stamp is the mark, the high-contrast Indian display face is the seal's voice, and a night-forest ground lets the gold stamp carry the pack.

Category shelf (judgement, sites unreachable here): maroon/red + gold foil with monuments and crowns (India Gate, Daawat, Kohinoor, Lal Qilla), purple/navy script (Tilda), leaf-green kraft and badges (24 Mantra, Organic Tattva).
All faces are OFL Google Fonts designed with both Latin and Devanagari, so Hindi lines use the brand's own type rather than a fallback.
